title: Brick Snap
about: BRICK SNAP: an 8-bit block puzzle with toy bricks. Snap three bricks at a time onto the baseplate; full rows and columns pop off together, and popping snap after snap builds a streak. Written in Sprout.
line: An 8-bit block puzzle with toy bricks on SPROUT·8: snap them onto the baseplate, pop full rows and columns together, keep a streak going.
